verdict.rationale: The docs explicitly point to a first-party Batch Processing API for high-volume processing, offer asynchronous screening for high-volume scenarios, and support bulk data exports by type and date range. However, the batch API is mentioned only once with no detail. Key per-item operations such as monitoring configuration are documented as single-customer endpoints. Missing for 10: documented batch API scope, payloads and limits; bulk case/alert remediation or bulk monitor/unmonitor actions; hands-on or independent corroboration.
